author: goshe7
body:
[https://playorna.com/terms/](https://playorna.com/terms/)

What you describe sounds a mechanical device providing repeated tapping in a single location.  Section 7 explicitly prohibits automation software but doesn't seem to address automation hardware.  

It sounds like it *technically* doesn't violate the terms.  If you need to argue on a technicality, it is pretty clear that it is going against the spirit of the terms.  Maybe it won't be a problem.  If it is flagged, maybe you can successfully appeal.  

I personally wouldn't take the risk.

author: ovedengrove
body:
1: they can't detect external clicking devices
2: I doubt they will ban cause of auto-clickers at all, I can't say that for sure of course but it's more likely aimed at gps simulation. 

3. This is not a clicker game and now I'm curious as to how you are playing when raiding xD

author: VanZandtVS
body:
Right now any automation is against the ToS, though I personally I don't see the harm in some automation.

By the time you're midway through t10 (with some ascension levels and moderate gear) even hard boss dungeons are single button presses every floor once you've got your buffs up.  

If Odie released a patch tomorrow that introduced a feature allowing you to automate the pressing of a single button of your choice it would be a massive quality of life improvement. 

I personally feel like Odie cares more about people using automation to bot the whole game or GPS spoofers, because there's plenty of high level players running auto clickers to automates their dungeons after their buff cycles and you don't see them getting banned.

author: nakourou
body: I use software like android to windows or samsung flow (if you have a samsung device) or any apple program to stream your phone to your computer, that allows you to use a mouse for clicks. It massively reduced my finger pain from tapping over and over without automating anything

author: Yani-Madara
body:
It would be too hard to tell it apart from other people watching TV or something and smashing the button over and over. Banning over that would cause accidental bans.

Like someone else said, don't ask don't tell.

Also the TOS refers to using spoofing and bots.

author: Drunkturtle7
body:
"Last month we made a lot raids and fingers/hands of me and my wife got really hurtfull some times to the point we thought about quitting."
